BEHIND THE ARCADE

A home for your downtime.

COZES GAMES is an independent browser-game portal. No account, no sign-up—just a collection of games to explore.

The collection

Game entries come from the Ultimate Game Stash published document. Navigation, methods, aggregate singlefile collections, and apps are excluded. The playable catalog uses individually matched upstream game files.

Your space, on your device

Favorites and recently opened games are stored locally in your browser. COZES adds no analytics. Third-party games and image hosts have their own policies and may make external requests.

A little credit

All games, trademarks, and artwork belong to their respective creators. COZES GAMES is not affiliated with those creators. Availability and device compatibility vary. See the included README and artwork credits for sources and hosting details.
